info.title: PACT Developer Platform v1
info.description: Solana Devnet only. Public lookup is not authentication. No server signing/broadcast or registry. Authentication supports an explicitly opted-in single persistent Node process; multi-instance/serverless auth is unsupported.

get.description: Cheap process/handler liveness; no RPC or authentication grant. Bypasses handler admission budgets so an overloaded public pool does not appear to be a dead process. Apply connection and URI limits at the hosting proxy.

error.description: Bounded non-exhaustive serde TransactionError string/object, not a complete version-specific enum list. Max4096UTF8 bytes, depth6, identifier keys; prototype keys refused.

Transaction.description: Runtime binds requested signature/network and slot<=contextSlot. not-found requires null slot/error; successful states require null error; failed requires non-null bounded TransactionError.
